title: Factuality of Large Language Models: A Survey
best_for_zh: 需要设计事实性评测或理解幻觉缓解结论的读者。
one_line: An EMNLP 2024 survey of why LLM answers can be factually wrong and how factuality is evaluated and improved.
系统梳理大语言模型事实性错误的成因、改进方法与开放式生成的评测难点。
why: It shows why a fluent answer is not enough and why factuality checks for open-ended generation remain difficult.
inclusion_reason: An accepted EMNLP survey that helps readers reason about factual accuracy separately from fluency and usefulness.

title: Problem
问题
html: Chat-oriented LLMs can give direct answers instead of forcing people to search and combine sources, but a direct, fluent answer can still contain unsupported or incorrect claims. This is especially consequential when a user has no easy way to inspect the model's basis for an answer. This EMNLP 2024 survey studies factuality as a reliability problem in open-ended generation: it discusses the challenges and causes behind incorrect content, the kinds of approaches researchers use to improve factuality, and the difficulty of automatically judging generated text whose wording and claims are not fixed in advance. It synthesizes prior literature rather than introducing a new factuality dataset, model, or single evaluation protocol.

面向对话的大语言模型能直接回答问题，减少人们搜索和整合信息的负担，但直接而流畅的回答仍可能包含没有依据或不正确的说法。尤其当用户难以查看模型回答依据时，这个问题更重要。这篇 EMNLP 2024 综述把事实性视为开放式生成中的可靠性问题：它讨论错误内容背后的挑战和成因、研究者用来提升事实性的不同思路，以及为什么自动判断措辞和断言都不预先固定的生成文本很困难。论文综合已有文献，不提出新的事实性数据集、模型或统一评测流程。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The paper treats factuality as a distinct reliability question rather than a by-product of fluent language: an answer may be coherent, helpful in tone, and still be wrong. Its central organizing idea is to connect four things that should be read together—major factuality challenges, their associated causes, possible improvement approaches, and the obstacles in measuring whether an answer is factual. This framing keeps a reader from treating a good-looking answer or a single automatic score as sufficient evidence. For broad, open-ended generation, the paper emphasizes that the relevant claim, supporting information, and judgment procedure all affect what a factuality result means.
论文把事实性视为独立的可靠性问题，而不是流畅语言自然带来的结果：回答可以连贯、语气有帮助，却仍然错误。它的核心整理方式是把四件事放在一起阅读：主要事实性挑战、与之相关的成因、可能的改进思路，以及衡量回答是否真实时遇到的障碍。这样的框架能避免读者把看起来不错的回答或单个自动分数当成充分证据。面对广泛的开放式生成，论文强调：所判断的断言、所依据的信息和具体判定过程，都会改变事实性结果的含义。

title: Method
方法
html: This paper is a critical literature survey, not a new model recipe or a shared benchmark. Its method is to collect and synthesize work concerned with evaluating and improving LLM factuality, then organize that work around challenges, causes, solution directions, and unresolved evaluation barriers. The synthesis deliberately distinguishes work that changes how a model generates from work that changes how factuality is judged, because those are different contributions. It uses this literature map to discuss future research directions. Readers who need exact model inputs, evidence sources, metrics, or experimental results should follow the survey's cited primary papers rather than infer those details from the survey alone.
这是一篇批判性文献综述，不是新的模型方案或共享基准。它汇集并综合与大语言模型事实性评测和提升有关的研究，再按挑战、成因、解决方向和仍未解决的评测障碍来整理这些工作。综述有意区分两类贡献：一类改变模型如何生成，另一类改变如何判断生成内容是否真实；二者并不相同。它据此讨论未来研究方向。若读者需要精确的模型输入、证据来源、指标或实验结果，应继续查看综述引用的原始论文，而不应仅从综述推断这些细节。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The survey's evidence base is the factuality literature it analyzes, rather than one newly collected experiment. Its central empirical warning is that factuality evaluation for open-ended generation still has unresolved obstacles. Therefore, an automatic score is not self-explanatory: a reader should ask what counts as factual in that setting, what source or reference information supports the judgment, which generated claims are being assessed, and how the final decision is produced. The same numeric result can be easier to interpret on a tightly specified task than on an unconstrained response containing several claims. Evidence should consequently be read together with the task setting and the judgment procedure.
综述的证据基础是它所分析的事实性文献，而不是一项新收集的实验。它的核心经验提醒是：开放式生成的事实性评测仍存在未解决的障碍。因此，自动分数本身不能说明一切：读者应追问，在该场景中什么算作真实、判定依据了什么来源或参考信息、评估了生成答案中的哪些断言，以及最终决定是怎样得到的。对于任务边界严格的回答，同一个数值可能比包含多个断言的自由回答更容易解释。因而，证据应始终与任务设置和判定过程一起阅读。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Instead of treating every incorrect answer as the same kind of failure, the paper offers a field-level organization around challenges, causes, improvement possibilities, and evaluation limitations. Its contribution is not a claim that it solves factuality with one mechanism; it gives readers a structure for separating different questions that are often collapsed in descriptions of hallucination. When a paper reports an improvement, this structure helps ask whether the change concerns the model's generation behavior, the quality or scope of the measurement, or both. It also makes clear that a better result under one judgment setup does not by itself establish broad factual reliability.
论文没有把所有错误回答视为同一种失败，而是从领域层面围绕挑战、成因、改进可能性和评测局限来整理研究。它的贡献不是声称用一个机制解决了事实性，而是给读者一个框架，分开理解在“幻觉”描述中常被混为一谈的问题。某篇论文报告改进时，这个框架有助于追问：改变的是模型的生成行为、测量的质量或覆盖范围，还是两者都有？它也提醒读者，在某一种判定设置下得到更好结果，并不自动证明模型具有广泛的事实可靠性。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The survey does not establish one universal factuality metric, one shared evidence source, or a guarantee that a proposed method transfers across domains and response formats. Its coverage is bounded by the literature available when it was written. More importantly, the paper explicitly highlights the difficulty of automated assessment for open-ended generation: a system must handle varied wording, potentially multiple claims, and task-dependent notions of supporting information. The survey is therefore best used as a map for posing careful questions, not as a substitute for checking a method's primary evaluation setup. Claims about a system's factuality should retain the limits of the evidence on which they depend.
综述没有给出通用的事实性指标、统一的证据来源，也不保证某种方法能跨领域和跨回答形式有效。它的覆盖范围受写作时可获得文献限制。更重要的是，论文明确指出开放式生成的自动评测困难：系统需要处理多样的表述、可能同时出现的多个断言，以及随任务变化的支持信息定义。因此，这篇综述最适合用来提出更谨慎的问题，而不能替代对具体方法原始评测设置的检查。关于系统事实性的结论应保留其所依赖证据的边界。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper before choosing a hallucination or factuality benchmark, interpreting a vendor claim, or designing an open-ended evaluation. It helps turn the broad statement “the model is more factual” into a concrete reading checklist: factual with respect to which source or evidence, for what kind of generated claim, under which prompts and task conditions, and judged by what procedure? It is also useful when comparing two results that use different reference materials or automatic measures. The survey does not select a benchmark for the reader; it helps the reader identify which properties a suitable benchmark and judgment setup need to make visible.
在选择幻觉或事实性基准、解读厂商说法，或设计开放式评测之前，可先读这篇论文。它能把“模型更有事实性”这种宽泛说法变成具体的阅读清单：相对于什么来源或证据、针对哪种生成断言、在何种提示和任务条件下，以及由什么判定过程得出？当两个结果使用不同的参考材料或自动指标时，它也有助于进行比较。综述不会替读者选定一个基准，但会帮助读者识别合适的基准和判定设置应当清楚呈现哪些属性。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Start with the paper's map of challenges and causes, then use its organization to read later work without overgeneralizing. For each method, record the target kind of factual error, the source or evidence used for judgment, the form of the generated answer, and whether the result concerns a closed benchmark or open-ended generation. Also record whether a reported gain comes from changing generation, changing the evaluator, or changing both. When a result looks strong, check whether its evaluation asks about one specified claim or several claims in a free response. These notes make it easier to compare papers while preserving the boundary of each result.
可先从论文给出的挑战与成因图谱读起，再利用它的整理方式阅读后续工作，避免过度概括。对于每种方法，应记录目标事实错误的类型、判定所用的来源或证据、生成答案的形式，以及结果针对封闭基准还是开放式生成。同时记录报告的提升来自改变生成、改变评估器，还是两者皆有。若结果看起来很强，还应查看评测是在问一个明确断言，还是自由回答中的多个断言。这些笔记能帮助比较论文，同时保留每个结果的适用边界。
